title: Frontend: Asterisk Field Validation
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Asterisk Field Validation. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Name and Email are required after trimming. Email must satisfy a basic local@domain.tld form; Note is optional. Return trimmed {name,email,note}; any failure shows Required fields invalid. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Name, Email, Note. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use required attributes and visible labels; an asterisk alone does not explain a requirement.
alternativeApproaches: Support conditional requirements without leaving hidden fields invalid or unreachable.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Whitespace-only value; missing required field; optional blank field.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
